notes: Enforced by static guard, not just convention: package5_control_plane_runtime_guard.py:500-509 parses each of the three functions and fails unless the body is EXACTLY one statement equal to `return 0` / `return 0` / `return []`. The same guard bans `import pywebpush` in any active .py (:702-703), bans calls to `webpush`, `_save_master_push_subscription`, `_push_db`, `_list_master_push_subscriptions_sqlite`, `_delete_master_push_subscription_sqlite` (:709-710), and bans any SQL touching `MASTER_PUSH_SUBSCRIPTIONS`/`CLIENT_PUSH_SUBSCRIPTIONS` (:711-714). NET EFFECT: transactional booking pushes («Вы записаны», перенос, отмена) and the tip-offer push are silently never delivered from the Python stack — their only live route is the NestJS Communication Delivery types listed above, which do NOT include a record-created/rescheduled/cancelled type.

Breaks the device chain if an invitation slot did not succeed (:104-107). Provided by crm.module.ts:99 (CrmModule, app.module.ts:91).

evidence: expense-reminder.scheduler.ts:25-32 — `onModuleInit` returns early unless `EXPENSE_REMINDERS_CANONICAL_ENABLED === 'true'` (:26-29), then `setInterval(..., 60000).unref()`. `tickTenant` :37-75 asserts a pure system principal (`context.source === 'system'`, matching tenantId, NO userId — else `throw new Error('Canonical system expense initiator required')`, :38-44), resumes retained runs with `executions: {some: {state: {in: ['READY','UNKNOWN']}}}` (:47-61) BEFORE computing the current week via `expenseWeek(tenant.defaultTimezone, this.store.clock())` (:62-65) and admitting a new run (:66-73). `resume()` :76-104 re-asserts the principal and skips slots already terminal (:88-93). Type constant: expense-reminder.contract.ts:12 `EXPENSE_REMINDER_TYPE = 'weekly_expense_reminder'`. Registered expense-intake.module.ts:30; module app.module.ts:67.

Uniquely among these types the kernel forces `channel !== 'inbox'` — it requires `normalizedInput.channel !== 'telegram'` to FAIL, i.e. Telegram is mandatory (action-engine.kernel.ts:1598-1615); registry carve-outs at action-engine.registry.ts:403,409.
